message.content:
Olanzapine is a thienobenzodiazepine, so the relevant heading is 3004 (medicaments in measured doses or retail packings). Its subheading 3004.90 covers other medicaments, and the 10-digit statistical suffix needs to be identified from there.

HTSUS 3004.90.92 is "Other" under 3004.90.9x. The 3004.90.91 line covers other medicaments, and 3004.90.92 is "Other: Other". The usual lines are:

- 3004.90.10: Antiasthmatics, etc.
- 3004.90.20: ...
- 3004.90.91: Medicaments for treating... (a catch-all not specifically listed)
- 3004.90.92: Other (this is the statistical suffix commonly used for CNS agents)

Customs rulings on olanzapine have used 3004.90.9255, "Other: Other: Other: Other: Psychotherapeutic agents". I'm not fully certain of that suffix, but it matches my recollection of the CNS-agent suffixes under 3004.90.92 (3004.90.9215 for the first group, and so on). I'll go with 3004.90.9255 as my best recollection.
